image:image.image:title: Overview - Upskill and earn digital badges
image:image.image:caption: Develop new skills and earn digital badges. These multi-level badges let your peers and future employers know of your additional skillsets. These badges can be viewed on your online portfolio and LinkedIn profile. “This overall experience with 3D printing and the Innovation Hub can simply be described as a great learning experience. From starting with barely any knowledge on the process to now feeling comfortable and proficient, is amazing growth.” – Ashley Becklund, Interior Architecture & Design student

image:image.image:title: Overview - “The interns are ready to help anyone from beginners to the most experienced with their projects.”
image:image.image:caption: — FSU News, February 2020 The Innovation Hub’s interns come from many disciplines and united by a common interest in emerging technologies and design thinking. They are happy to help anyone who comes to the Hub to try out 3D printing, laser cutting, experience virtual reality, and more.
